# Environment Format Reference

Use these examples as patterns, not as universal templates. Inspect the project first and adapt to its real run commands.

## Simple Command

Use a single-line command when the project has one reliable startup entrypoint.

```toml
# THIS IS AUTOGENERATED. DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
version = 1
name = "desktop-app"

[setup]
script = ""

[[actions]]
name = "运行"
icon = "run"
command = "make run-gui"
```

## Subdirectory Frontend

Use a multiline literal string when changing directories or preparing local environment variables.

```toml
# THIS IS AUTOGENERATED. DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
version = 1
name = "web-app"

[setup]
script = ""

[[actions]]
name = "运行"
icon = "run"
command = '''
cd frontend
bun dev
'''
```

## Multi-Process Frontend And Backend

Use `bash -lc`, cleanup traps, and a health check when one action starts several cooperating processes.

```toml
# THIS IS AUTOGENERATED. DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
version = 1
name = "full-stack-app"

[setup]
script = ""

[[actions]]
name = "运行"
icon = "run"
command = '''
bash -lc '
set -e

cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${api_pid:-}" ]; then
    kill "$api_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

(
  cd backend
  make run-api
) &
api_pid=$!

until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8084/healthz >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  sleep 1
done

cd frontend
[ -d node_modules ] || bun install
bun x vite dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3002
'
'''
```

## Kubernetes Port-Forward Development

Use local kubeconfig paths and background port-forwards only when the existing dev workflow requires live cluster services.

```toml
# THIS IS AUTOGENERATED. DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
version = 1
name = "cluster-backed-app"

[setup]
script = ""

[[actions]]
name = "运行"
icon = "run"
command = '''
export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/dev
kubectl -n dev-services port-forward svc/postgres 5432:5432 &
kubectl -n dev-services port-forward svc/redis 6379:6379 &
pnpm dev
'''
```

## Quoting Notes

- Prefer TOML literal strings `'''...'''` for multiline shell commands.
- If the shell command itself uses single quotes, wrap it carefully and validate the TOML after editing.
- Prefer `cd "/absolute/path"` when paths contain spaces or the action may run from an unknown working directory.
- Keep the foreground dev server as the last command so the action does not exit immediately.
